papers.title: OpenMHC: Accelerating the Science of Wearable Foundation Models
papers.what: Releases the largest open-access wearable health dataset to date (over 60 million hours, 19 sensor channels, up to 169 linked variables, 11,894 participants) plus open-source reference models and a three-track benchmark for prediction, imputation, and forecasting.
papers.builds_on: GLOBEM (Xu 2023, ICD9EG8Q); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); SSL for HAR 700K Person-days (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW)

papers.title: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution
papers.what: Trains a single policy to alternate between solving a task and curating an evolving skill document for the next task, with decoupled credit assignment; gains 2.3 to 8.5 points Pass@1 over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld and shows test-time scaling across tasks.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV)

papers.title: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization
papers.what: Splits the response-level GRPO advantage across tokens by rescoring a response with and without the rubric criteria and using the token log-likelihood contrast as a credit weight, with no auxiliary scorer; improves matched response-level GRPO by 4.4 points on average.

papers.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
papers.what: Introduces shadow evaluations where a frontier agent answers the central question of an unpublished paper and the original authors grade it; on two NeurIPS 2026 submissions the agents did all engineering but made no substantial research progress and were rejected, with five named failure modes.
papers.builds_on: Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024, Z9WZPMNU); Memory Mechanisms of Foundation Agents (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV)
